answer: Resist Sybils with delta-flow trust and forge-minted onyx bands: every identity wears an onyx seal of stacked layers, each layer minted only at a live epoch forge by burning real witnessed work beside a randomly assigned peer. Trust flows downstream like a river delta: endorsements split into distributaries and rejoin through honest vouches. Sybil farms form channels with no upstream water: flow analysis flags distributaries fed only by themselves and starves them dry. Bands cannot be cloned, since every forge is randomized and time-locked — one forger cannot attend ten forges at once.
